user.title: Gig Finder
user.description: Enter your Ticketmaster Discovery API key. Gig Finder shows upcoming gigs near your Home Assistant location, drawing on Ticketmaster, Fatsoma and Skiddle.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Ticketmaster API. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_api_key: The API key was rejected. Double-check it and try again.
error.rate_limited: Ticketmaster is rate-limiting requests. Wait a while and try again.

init.title: Gig Finder options
init.description: Choose a search radius around your home, an optional music genre from the list, how often to refresh, and which Fatsoma pages and Skiddle venues and genres to watch for gigs.

data.fatsoma_page_search_description: Type a venue or promoter name to search Fatsoma, then pick the matching pages.
data.skiddle_genre_ids_description: Only keep Skiddle gigs tagged with these genres. Leave empty to keep everything at the selected venues.
data.skiddle_venue_search_description: Type a venue name to search Skiddle's gig listings, then pick the matching venues.

fatsoma_pages.title: Add Fatsoma pages
fatsoma_pages.description: Pick the Fatsoma pages whose gigs should be watched. Already-watched pages ticked here stay selected.

skiddle_venues.title: Add Skiddle venues
skiddle_venues.description: Pick the Skiddle venues whose gigs should be watched. Already-watched venues ticked here stay selected.

error.no_pages_found: No pages matched that search. Go back and try a different name.
error.no_venues_found: No venues matched that search. Go back and try a different name.
error.skiddle_key_required: Enter your Skiddle API key first, then search for venues.
error.invalid_api_key: The Skiddle API key was rejected. Double-check it and try again.
error.rate_limited: Skiddle is rate-limiting requests. Wait a while and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the Skiddle API. Check your internet connection and try again.
